initiatives.name: Corporate Investments Unit Asset Disposals
initiatives.summary: L&G has executed cumulative disposals of £1.5bn in assets from its Corporate Investments Unit as part of reducing downside risk. The company plans to materially sell down these assets by end of 2027 at current valuations.

evidence.title: Corporate Investments Unit asset disposals programme

evidence.quote: Cumulative disposals of £1.5bn assets in Corporate Investments Unit

initiatives.name: US Protection Business Divestiture
initiatives.summary: L&G completed the disposal of its US Protection business as part of its strategic focus, while simultaneously growing its partnership with Meiji Yasuda. This transaction involved building a 5% shareholding with Meiji Yasuda.

initiatives.name: Workplace Administration Capability Investment
initiatives.summary: L&G has increased its investment in workplace administration capabilities, with allocated investment spend of £46m supporting wider retail lifetime value and Asset Management fee growth. This represents continued investment in their workplace offering.

initiatives.name: Share Buyback Programme
initiatives.summary: L&G completed £700m in share buybacks for 2024-2025 and is commencing the first tranche of a £1.2bn share buyback programme. This represents a significant capital return to shareholders with an all-in yield of 17%.

evidence.title: Share buyback programme implementation

evidence.quote: Grew dividend per share to 21.79p and completed £700m share buybacks (2024-2025) Commencing first tranche of £1.2bn share buyback; delivering an all-in yield of 17%
